identification_strategy: One-line: DID — treatment = blocks with Jewish institutions, control = blocks more than two blocks away from Jewish institutions; shock/instrument/cutoff = terrorist attack on July 18, 1994

key_variables.treatment: Blocks that contain a Jewish institution
key_variables.control: Blocks more than two blocks away from the nearest Jewish institution
key_variables.outcome: Number of car thefts per block

conclusion_detail: Police presence significantly reduces car thefts in blocks with Jewish institutions.
main_effect: Relative to the control group, car thefts fall by 75% in the blocks in which the protected institutions are situated.
notes: The effect is extremely local, with no evidence of spillover to nearby blocks. Confidence is less than 1.0 due to potential unobserved factors affecting crime rates.
